SALT SHED & BOAT HOUSE OPM  - RANKING SHEET  
 
Consultant Name:                                                                                       
              
Reviewer:                                                                                               . 
 
Submission Requirements:  The non-priced proposal shall include the following 
A. Background history and experience  
B. Description of recent similar projects, a list of recent clients, and references   
C. Qualifications of key personnel and any subconsultants to be assigned 
D. A plan of services with proposed scope of work & project schedule  
E. Good working knowledge of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts procurement laws   
F. Thorough knowledge of the Mass. Building Codes, ADA Act, and applicable construction-related codes and 
regulations 
G. A completed DSB Application Form 
H. A Certificate of Non-Collusion 
I. A Tax Compliance Certification 
J. An IRS form W-9 
 
   DECISION TO USE COMPETITIVE SEALED PROPOSALS: 
 
The Chief Procurement Officer has determined that in order to select the most advantageous proposal for services 
(“Services”) related to the scope of work contained in the RFP, comparative judgments of technical factors, in 
addition to price, will be necessary for the following reasons: 
 
1. The City of Malden has determined there are factors beyond minimum quality requirements which require 
comparative judgements of factors in addition to price.  
 
2. As such, the determination has been made that the City places a premium on criteria above and beyond 
best price. 
The City’s evaluation committee shall review, evaluate and rate each proposer’s technical (non-price) 
information. After this rating has been reviewed and accepted, the most qualified candidates, as determined by 
the City, may be interviewed and provided the opportunity to explain and supplement the information contained 
in their proposals. After the final selection is made, the selected candidate shall provide the City a detailed 
breakdown of the estimated labor and expenses the candidate believes are necessary to perform each task.  All 
related cost information requested by the City shall be furnished by the candidate for the purpose of complete 
disclosure during negotiations.  If an acceptable price can be negotiated, a contract will be executed.  If an 
agreement cannot be reached, then negotiations with the top-ranked firm are closed and the second-ranked firm 
is invited to undertake negotiations.  This process can continue to the third-ranked firm and beyond, if 
agreement cannot be reached.   
 
The City reserves the right to reject any or all proposals and to only award a contract it deems is in the best 
interest of the City.
2 
 
Minimum Qualifications: Applicants must be a registered Professional Engineer or Registered Architect in the 
Commonwealth of Massachusetts. Applicants must possess a minimum of five (5) years of experienced construction 
supervision of public buildings. Applicants who are not registered engineers or architects must possess a minimum of 
seven (7) years of relevant experience. 
   Comparative Evaluation Criteria:    Check Applicable Rating    
 
The City of Malden shall apply the criteria, which follows, in its evaluation of the proposals.  The purpose of 
the information requested in this section is to assist the evaluation committee in making decisions about the 
proposers overall qualifications, including technical abilities and previous experience.  Proposers should clearly 
respond in writing to each criterion as enumerated, responses to the following areas shall be complete and full. 
 
The Committee will evaluate each proposal for conformance with the objectives, submission requirements, and 
criteria outlined in this Request for Proposals.  Preference categories have been established for the purpose of 
further distinguishing competitive proposals. In addition, the preference categories will be used 
to compare the relative advantages of each competing proposal.   
 
The ratings of "Highly Advantageous, "Advantageous", "Not Advantageous", and/or “Unacceptable” will be 
used to evaluate each proposal using the following evaluation criteria. The following preference categories must 
be addressed in the proposal:   
 
1. Completion of projects of a comparable size, nature, and complexity. 
 
Ratings  OPM Experience. 
Highly Advantageous  The proposer has at least fifteen (15) years experience in 
completing projects of a comparable size, nature, and complexity.  
Experience with municipal facilities and/or experience working 
with municipal government agencies a plus. 
 
Advantageous  The proposer has at least ten (10) years experience in completing  
projects of a comparable size, nature, and complexity. 
 
Not Advantageous  The proposer has less than ten (10) years experience in completing  
projects of a comparable size, nature, and complexity. 
2.  Qualifications and experience of the designated project manager. 
Ratings  OPM Experience. 
Highly Advantageous  The proposer has at least ten (10) years of related  
experience and required qualifications and professional  
background. 
 
Advantageous  The proposer has at least five (5) years experience in completing  
projects of a comparable size, nature, and complexity. 
 
Not Advantageous  The proposer has less than five (5) years experience in completing  
projects of a comparable size, nature, and complexity.
3 
 
 3. Demonstrated ability to complete projects on a timely basis. 
 
Ratings  OPM Experience. 
Highly Advantageous  All of the proposer’s references indicate that the projects were  
completed on schedule of with minimal, insignificant delays. 
 
Advantageous  Only one of the proposer’s references indicates that the project was 
completed with substantial delays attributable to the proposer, and  
no current project or project completed in the last three (3) years 
experienced substantial delays attributable to the proposer. 
Not Advantageous  Two of the proposer’s references indicate that the project was  
completed with substantial delays attributable to the proposer, and  
no current project or project completed in last year experienced 
substantial delays attributable to the proposer. 
 
Unacceptable  More than two of the proposer’s references indicate that the project 
was completed with substantial delays attributable to the proposer.  
4. Plan of services methodology. 
Ratings  OPM Experience. 
Highly Advantageous  The plan of services proposed a detailed timeline for completing  
the project. 
 
Advantageous  The plan of services proposed a credible scheme for completing  
the project. 
 
Not Advantageous  The plans of services is not sufficiently detailed to fully evaluate,  
or the plan does not contain all the components necessary to complet  
the project.
